extraction_notes: Extracted SI experimental catalyst-performance data from SI Table S3 rows marked 'This work' and the readable CO2/H2 portion of SI Figure S54. Literature-comparison rows from references 8–18 in SI Table S3 were excluded. SI Figure S10 contains dense plotted conversion/selectivity data, but SI Table S3 provides the printed conversion and methanol-selectivity values for the same temperature series; individual CO/CH4 selectivities from the stacked bars were not extracted because they are not reliably readable. CO/H2-only data in SI Figure S54 were excluded as out of scope.
